name: feature-highlights
title: Feature Highlight Cards
description: A black highlights block with a pink eyebrow, a big white question as the heading, and three bordered cards each with an icon, blurb and a Learn more link.
use: A dark page needs three equal benefit cards with short blurbs and a link each.
avoid: Three cards are hardcoded, and the long blurbs make cards taller than one screenful.
a11y: Learn more buttons have no visible focus ring and the icons are unlabelled; the pink cue rides on hover alone. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black field of three equal dark cards with thin grey outlines, rounded corners and generous padding. Each opens with a small pink outlined icon, then a bold white title, grey body copy and a pale Learn more link with an arrow.
behaves: Hovering a card lightens its fill from near-black to dark grey and turns its Learn more link pink along with the arrow. Nothing else moves.
customise: Card icons, titles and copy come from the darkFeatures array; hover colours and padding are class names.
weight: light: Three static cards with colour transitions on hover.
